content_fingerprint.note: Any byte change to the content artifact voids this form and the packet.

decision_requirements: A decision requires reviewer (named human specialist, never AI, >= 3 non-blank chars), reviewer_role_or_credential (operator-validated), reviewed_at (date-time), and rationale (>= 10 non-blank chars) together; optional evidence never substitutes for them.
no_effect_statement: This form grants no approval and has no mechanical effect. Blank or null NEVER reads as approval. Only an authorized human reviewer may fill the decision, identity, role/credential, timestamp, evidence, and rationale fields. Even a filled form changes nothing: applying any decision to the content artifact is a separate, separately reviewed milestone with its own fingerprint gates.
import_eligible_effect: none - import_eligible stays false; flipping it is a later, separately approved act on an exact fingerprinted payload (validator rule R6)
publication_effect: none - publication is a separate database-side lifecycle; pending or rejected content can never be published structurally
loading_effect: none - catalog loading remains blocked until an authorized review decision is recorded AND separately reviewed
